name: Admin Clients Filter Presets
description: Admin reads /panel/clients by business module instead of a flat strip of filters. Level 1 is the module (Todos, Propuestas, Diagnóstico, Proyectos, Hosting, Contabilidad, Documentos, Emails): picking one does NOT narrow the list, it decides which subfilters level 2 offers, which is what lets a module hold both a cut and its complement ('Con hosting cobrado' next to 'Sin hosting'). Level 2 holds the twenty-three subfilters — the seven proposal-status cuts (code-level entries since migration 0049 dropped their seeded rows), 'Con proyecto activo'/'Sin proyecto', the three hosting ones, 'Sin datos de facturacion', and the three Documentos cuts ('Con documentos', 'Sin documentos', 'Con documentos sin proyecto' — the review list the retroactive folder pass leaves behind). Each carries its match count in parentheses, always shown, (0) included, computed over the loaded rows after the status and search cuts, so the number equals what pressing it returns. The hosting and project cuts read the FK-backed aggregates from PA-25 (active_hostings_count / active_projects_count); the Documentos cuts read documents_count / documents_no_project_count (active documents linked via Document.client_user). Selecting a subfilter stamps ?clientTab=<id> and ?clientModule=<module> so the link survives a reload and can be shared; pressing it again clears the cut but stays in the module. Subfilters are values of the filter panel's own controls, so every one of them can also be rebuilt from the panel, combined with each other and with the panel's advanced filters, saved as a named tab under its module, and removed by its chip — which drops the tab highlight with it, since tab, chip and panel are one state. Chips name the module they come from. Whatever does not fit the row moves into a 'Más' menu rather than being clipped. The client status (Todos/Activos/Huerfanos/Inactivos) is transversal: it sits next to the search box, carries its own server-computed counts, travels in ?status= and combines with any module. Deactivated clients stay out by default (the endpoint hides them) even when they still hold live hostings. While the Hosting module is being read each row shows its hosting count, which for superusers doubles as the jump into /panel/accounting/hostings?client=<id>, landing there already filtered; while Documentos is active the row shows '<N> docs · <fecha del último>' (client-documents-<id>, no superuser gate) jumping into /panel/documents?client=<id>. At 412px and 835px only search plus one filter summary precede the first client; status, module, subfilter, advanced filters and view settings live in one bottom drawer in that order. Client rows become stacked summaries with identity, company, email, counts, context and a 44px Actions entry; expanded detail tables become labeled cards and proposal/diagnostic reassignment gains an explicit touch action. From 1195px the two-level tab architecture remains visible, and the page is capped at 1400px on the 2560px monitor. La búsqueda publica lista y contadores del mismo corte, oculta resultados anteriores sin coincidencias y permite reintentar si falla la lectura de filas o contadores.
